# Paraxe

> Token-driven UI components, editable registry blocks, and independently configurable design recipes for Vue and React.

Published npm and immutable registry releases can lag behind development. Read release status before choosing an API. Registry installation copies editable source into the application; blocks do not provide authentication, payments, persistence, or backend services.

- [Release status](https://tobiwebdeveloper.github.io/paraxe-registry/docs/reference/release-status.md): Published versions and development boundary.
- [Start here](https://tobiwebdeveloper.github.io/paraxe-registry/docs/guides/start-here.md): System layers and workflow.
- [Install and theme](https://tobiwebdeveloper.github.io/paraxe-registry/docs/guides/install-and-theme.md): Dependencies and CSS order.
- [Core components](https://tobiwebdeveloper.github.io/paraxe-registry/docs/guides/core-components.md): Complete Vue and React examples.
- [Editable blocks](https://tobiwebdeveloper.github.io/paraxe-registry/docs/guides/using-blocks.md): CLI installation, customization, and ownership.
- [Binary assets](https://tobiwebdeveloper.github.io/paraxe-registry/docs/registry/binary-assets.md): Published schema 2, byte integrity, backward compatibility, and rollout boundary.
- [AI implementation guide](https://tobiwebdeveloper.github.io/paraxe-registry/docs/guides/ai-implementation.md): Evidence-first implementation rules.
- [Development contracts](https://tobiwebdeveloper.github.io/paraxe-registry/docs/reference/current-contracts.md): Exact source contracts; verify installed declarations.
- [Block and recipe formula](https://tobiwebdeveloper.github.io/paraxe-registry/docs/block-and-recipe-formula.md): Distinct layouts, product purpose, and token discipline.
